_readme: Labelled headlines for company tagging (the stock chip on a news card, the 'Latest news' line on a stock card, the headlines in the stock popup). expect is the stock id the headline is about, or null when it is about no listed company. level 'warn' marks a known limit of keyword matching that is reported but does not block publishing. Add a case whenever a wrong tag is spotted.
